def enclosing_blob(g, cells):
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    R0,R1,C0,C1=r0,r1,c0,c1
    def solid(R0,R1,C0,C1):
        return all(g[r][c]!=0 for r in range(R0,R1+1) for c in range(C0,C1+1))
    assert solid(R0,R1,C0,C1), 'not solid'
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        if R0>0 and solid(R0-1,R1,C0,C1): R0-=1; changed=True
        if R1<29 and solid(R0,R1+1,C0,C1): R1+=1; changed=True
        if C0>0 and solid(R0,R1,C0-1,C1): C0-=1; changed=True
        if C1<29 and solid(R0,R1,C0+1,C1): C1+=1; changed=True
    return R0,R1,C0,C1
